verdict.rationale: Twenty ships an AI chatbot that answers natural-language questions about CRM data, plus AI agents that enrich records, score opportunities based on engagement patterns, and execute multi-step tasks, all scoped by role-based permissions. This directly matches AI-generated insights/suggestions from data inside the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of these AI features' quality (evidence is entirely first-party docs) and no concrete examples of insight accuracy or real-world usage reports.
